name: benchflow-ai
description: BenchFlow AI: bench assistant, upskilling recommender, and learning-plan portal (Angular + Express + TypeScript)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix server run format && npm --prefix client run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix server run format:check && npm --prefix client run format:check
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
